cues.description: The cues with a hold or actor movement, in cue order

delay.description: Wait before this step starts, after GO or the previous step (s)

moveTime.description: Time to walk to this step's position; missing = walking speed (s)

visible.description: On stage (false = off stage, not drawn)

position.description: Position [x, y, z] in stage coordinates (x to the audience's right, y up, z towards the audience) (m)

facing.description: Facing, around the vertical: 0 = towards the audience (°)

cue.description: Cue number as in MagicQ, e.g. 12.5 (for reading; the id wins when both are there)

id.description: MagicQ's cue id (S record); missing = found by the cue number

hold.description: Wait after this cue has finished until the next GO (timeline, Auto, movie); missing = the default hold (s)

smoke.description: Smoke (haze) this cue sets, in % of the densest haze (the Haze slider's scale); it stays in the later cues until one sets another; missing = this cue leaves the smoke as it is (%)

smokeTime.description: Seconds the haze takes to build or thin to this cue's smoke amount, like a hazer; missing = 20 s (s)

scenery.description: Per set piece id (blocking/scenery.yaml): out / in at this cue's GO, how far a curtain opens

actors.description: Per actor id: the movement steps in this cue, one after the other

visible.description: true = the piece comes in at this cue's GO, false = it goes out (no fade); missing = as it is

open.description: How far a split curtain opens in this cue (0 = closed, 100 = open); missing = as it is (%)

time.description: Seconds the curtain takes to open or close; missing = 5 s (s)
